'''Zeltros''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]].<ref name="LECG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zeltros was mentioned in the ''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]'', a [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]] sourcebook published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] in [[2009]].<ref name="LECG" />
